WITH playlist_counts AS (
  SELECT p.PlaylistId, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS track_count
  FROM Playlist AS p
  LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack AS pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId
  GROUP BY p.PlaylistId
),
counts_with_average AS (
  SELECT PlaylistId, track_count, AVG(track_count) OVER () AS average_track_count
  FROM playlist_counts
)
SELECT PlaylistId,
       track_count,
       1.0 * track_count / NULLIF(average_track_count, 0) AS ratio
FROM counts_with_average
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;
